newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's RIBOR futures contract to start on June 2.
newsitem.headline: Italy's RIBOR futures contract to start on June 2.

text.p: Trading of a futures contract on one-month RIBOR, the Rome interbank offered rate, will start on Monday June 2 on the Italian futures market (MIF), a MIF official said.
The new contract will be traded by 13 market makers and MIF dealers, who will be allowed to quote prices on their own account.

The 13 market makers are Banca Commerciale Italiana, Banca del Salento, Banca di Roma, Monte dei Paschi di Siena, BNL, BNA, Banca Popolare di Milano, Banca Popolare di Verona-Banco S. Geminiano and San Prospero, Banco Bilbao Vizcaya, Cariplo, Credito Italiano, Istituto San Paolo and Societe Generale.
As previously announced, the dealing unit will be of three billion lire, delivery will be monthly and the last day of trading will be two working days preceding the third Wednesday of each month.
The price will be 100 minus the interest rate. Minimum movement will be one basis point and the minimum quotation by market makers will be of 10 lots.
There will be three expiries quoted and trading will be carried out between 0850 and 1710 local time.
